newsitem.title: NORWAY: Statoil farms out N.Sea stake to Deminex.
newsitem.headline: Statoil farms out N.Sea stake to Deminex.

text.p: Den norske stats oljeselskap AS (Statoil) said on Thursday it had sold 27 percent of block 9/3 in the Norwegian North Sea to German oil company Deminex.
The deal leaves state oil company Statoil with a 43 percent share in the block -- 73 percent including the government's direct financial interest.
Statoil said it had been seeking a new partner for further exploration on the acreage since it acquired the interests of Total, Saga Petroleum and DuPont's Conoco last year.

Subject to government approval of the farm-out, three dimensional seismic will be shot in spring in the area, which lies due east of the Yme field, Statoil said. Results from the seismic survey will form the basis for a decision on possible drilling.
Statoil said any finds in the area could be produced from the Yme platform.
